nodes.name: org2CloudSessionCommentsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Large Jotai atom module implementing fetch/cache/merge logic and a React hook for a session's comment threads, correlating comments with agent comment-tasks and live task state.

nodes.name: compareComments
nodes.summary: Comparator used to sort comments deterministically by creation time then id.

nodes.name: decideSessionCommentsFetch
nodes.summary: Decides whether a session's comments should be (re)fetched given the current cache entry, a force flag, and the current time.

nodes.name: findNewerEngineTaskSignature
nodes.summary: Compares embedded and sync-engine task lists to detect when the engine has newer task state than what's embedded locally.

nodes.name: groupCommentThreads
nodes.summary: Groups a flat list of comments into threads, attaching presence/read markers from the set of present event ids.

nodes.name: mergePresentEventIdEntries
nodes.summary: Merges multiple present-event-id tracking entries into a single deduplicated set.

nodes.name: countLiveComments
nodes.summary: Counts comments across threads that are considered live (not resolved/deleted).

nodes.name: useCloudFreshAccessToken
nodes.summary: Hook returning a function that yields a fresh, non-expired cloud access token, refreshing session state as needed.

nodes.name: useSessionComments
nodes.summary: Primary hook that loads, caches and keeps in sync all comment threads and agent tasks for a cloud session, exposing actions to add/edit/resolve comments.

nodes.name: org2CloudSessionSync.ts
nodes.summary: Encapsulates per-session push/pull state for Org2Cloud sync: tracks cursors, dedupes metadata pushes via content hashing, and pushes local session events and metadata to the cloud.

nodes.name: buildCloudSessionMetadata
nodes.summary: Builds the metadata payload (name, access mode, scope key, etc.) sent when pushing a session to the cloud.

nodes.name: Org2CloudSessionSync
nodes.summary: Stateful helper that tracks per-session push cursors and metadata hashes, and orchestrates pushing/rewriting a session's events and metadata to Org2Cloud.

nodes.name: org2CloudSharesClient.ts
nodes.summary: RPC client for Org2Cloud session share links: creates, revokes, lists and resolves shareable links that let non-org members view or fork a shared session.

nodes.name: callShareRpc
nodes.summary: Performs a POST call to a share RPC endpoint and normalizes error responses into Org2CloudShareError.

nodes.name: isCloudShareActive
nodes.summary: Checks whether a cloud session share is still active (not revoked or expired) at a given time.

nodes.name: createCloudSessionShare
nodes.summary: Creates a new shareable link for a cloud session via RPC.

nodes.name: revokeCloudSessionShare
nodes.summary: Revokes an existing session share link via RPC.

nodes.name: listCloudSessionShares
nodes.summary: Lists active share links for a session via RPC.

nodes.name: Org2CloudShareError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown by session-share RPC calls, carrying a stable error code and HTTP status.

nodes.name: org2CloudSyncAtoms.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the persisted Jotai atoms backing the Org2Cloud sync engine: repo scopes, sync enablement, push cursors, pushed-metadata cache, and collab-state/task cursors.

nodes.name: org2CloudSyncClient.ts
nodes.summary: RPC client for the core Org2Cloud sync API: repo-scope and sharing-floor settings, session metadata upserts, event append/rewrite, and listing/fetching/deleting synced sessions.

nodes.name: callSyncRpc
nodes.summary: Performs a POST call to a sync RPC endpoint and normalizes error responses into Org2CloudSyncError.

nodes.name: setOrgRepoScopes
nodes.summary: Updates the set of repo scopes an org shares via RPC.

nodes.name: setOrgSharingFloor
nodes.summary: Updates the minimum sharing/access floor for an org via RPC.

nodes.name: setMemberSharingFloor
nodes.summary: Updates the minimum sharing floor for a specific member via RPC.

nodes.name: upsertSessionMetadata
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a synced session's metadata record via RPC.

nodes.name: rewriteSessionEvents
nodes.summary: Rewrites (replaces) the stored event history for a synced session via RPC.

nodes.name: appendSessionEvents
nodes.summary: Appends new events to a synced session's event log via RPC.

nodes.name: listOrgSessions
nodes.summary: Lists synced sessions for an org, optionally filtered since a given timestamp, via RPC.

nodes.name: getSessionEvents
nodes.summary: Fetches the event log for a synced session, with optional pagination options, via RPC.

nodes.name: deleteSession
nodes.summary: Deletes a synced session and its events via RPC.

nodes.name: Org2CloudSyncError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown by sync RPC calls, carrying a stable error code and HTTP status.

nodes.name: org2CloudSyncEngine.testUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Test-only fixture factory providing mock Tauri event listeners, mock cloud clients, and a fully wired Org2CloudSyncEngine fixture for unit tests.

nodes.name: makeEvent
nodes.summary: Builds a mock synced-session event object with overridable id and display status for tests.

nodes.name: makeClient
nodes.summary: Builds a mock Org2Cloud sync client with jest/vitest mock functions standing in for each RPC call.

nodes.name: makeProjectsClient
nodes.summary: Builds a mock Org2Cloud projects client with mock functions for each RPC call.

nodes.name: makeTasksClient
nodes.summary: Builds a mock Org2Cloud comment-tasks client with mock functions for each RPC call.

nodes.name: makeTask
nodes.summary: Builds a mock comment task object with overridable fields for tests.

nodes.name: createEngineFixture
nodes.summary: Assembles a fully wired Org2CloudSyncEngine instance with mock deps for use in unit tests.

nodes.name: org2CloudSyncEngine.ts
nodes.summary: Central sync engine that orchestrates periodic Org2Cloud synchronization across all joined orgs: pushes/pulls sessions, projects, comment tasks and collab state, with per-org backoff and schema-version gating.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large stateful orchestration class (~750 lines, 18 methods) coordinating multiple RPC clients and sub-sync helpers; a prime candidate for future decomposition.

nodes.name: Org2CloudSyncEngine
nodes.summary: Long-running engine that periodically syncs sessions, projects, comment tasks and collab state for every org the user belongs to, handling schema gating, per-org backoff, and event-driven sync triggers.

nodes.name: org2CloudSyncLifecycle.ts
nodes.summary: Defines timing constants and a document-visibility helper controlling how frequently the Org2Cloud sync engine runs its sync passes in foreground vs background.

nodes.name: sessionCommentTarget.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves which cloud org/session a session-comments UI should target for a given local session, and a hook wrapping that resolution for components.

nodes.name: resolveSessionCommentTarget
nodes.summary: Determines the cloud org and session id that comments should be read from/written to for a given local session and its tagged cloud orgs.

nodes.name: useSessionCommentTarget
nodes.summary: Hook wrapping resolveSessionCommentTarget to derive the comment target for the currently active session.

nodes.name: useAddressCommentsSlashCommand.ts
nodes.summary: Registers a slash command that lets a user trigger an agent to address open review comments on the current session directly from the composer.

nodes.name: useAddressCommentsSlashCommand
nodes.summary: Hook that wires up the '/address-comments' slash command, collecting addressable threads and kicking off an address-comments run for the active session.
